candidates.name: api_guidance
candidates.hypothesis: Providing general API operational guidance in the system context (explicit access_token passing for authenticated calls, supervisor password store lookup, pagination looping, and multi-statement execution batching) will eliminate 401 authentication errors and credential discovery failures, reducing average turns per task by 20-30% and preventing step exhaustion timeouts on long tasks.
candidates.changes: Add general operational guidance to context_mgmt/default.py providing standard conventions for stateless API authentication, password retrieval, pagination, and multi-statement script batching.
candidates.expected_efficiency: Reduce mean turns from 20.8 to ~15.0 and cut total token usage by ~25%.
